name: Fugitive Flight
source:
You find yourself on a ship with three other refugees, fleeing the oppressive regime of your home star system. You're going to be stuck on this little freighter with them for a month while you flee a fascist government, so maybe fall in love with one of them? Or all of them?

[From [url=https://crawlabeegames.itch.io/fugitiveflight]itch.io[/url]]
